name: Git
purpose: Saves every version of your code and settings, so you can repeat an experiment and show exactly what you ran.
version_guidance: Install the latest stable release offered for your system.

windows.text: Download and run the Git for Windows installer from git-scm.com. The default options are fine for most students.

macos.text: Run the command below. If Git is missing, macOS offers to install the Command Line Tools, which include Git.

linux.text: On Debian or Ubuntu, install it with apt. On Fedora, use dnf.

common_problems.problem: Windows: git is not recognized after installing
common_problems.solution: Close the terminal and open a new one, so it picks up the new path.

common_problems.problem: You commit a large dataset by mistake
common_problems.solution: Keep datasets out of Git. Add the data folder to a .gitignore file before your first commit.

manual_review: The download link points to the official install chapter of the Git book. Confirm the direct downloads page for each system.
